name: hook-triage-stories-no-approval
description: A just-run post-stories hook is diagnostic, not edit approval. The reviewer's findings are offered as a numbered triage list and nothing is written — least of all a story file, which is exactly what this hook reviews. A finding the tech spec owns is routed, not applied.
prompt: mano stories. Continue the previous interaction: the active post-stories hook has just run and reported two raw findings in chat. (1) story 1's acceptance criteria never state what the person sees while a retry is in flight. (2) tech-spec.md gives the retry delay no maximum and recommends an 8-second cap. No finding has been approved yet. Handle the hook output according to Mano; do not treat running the hook as approval.
